response.sql:
WITH account_averages AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    AVG(CASE
          WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
          WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END) AS avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount >= 2400
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_account_signed_amount,
  AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
FROM account_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Cutoff at an amount of 2400” means include transactions with trans.amount >= 2400. The average across accounts is an unweighted average of each account’s transaction average; accounts with no qualifying PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction are excluded from the first figure by AVG ignoring NULLs.
